selection_rules: Uniform random shared scenario/item where paired comparisons are possible; fixed seed, deterministic sorted keys.
Stratify by model, condition and readout; same-item pairing retained only when verified.
Outcome-stratified failure/no-habit additions are separately labelled; no replacement of inconvenient random examples.
Source labels are existing labels only, not new model calls.
Main investigator reads full selected replies; displayed excerpts marked with exact omission/character offsets.
No handpicked example without selected-illustration label.
